days.title: Peaks and Wetlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: monte Corno
stops.detail: The highest peak is Mount Corno, which gives the park its name and reaches 1,817 m above sea level.

stops.name: lago Bianco
stops.detail: In the park there are some marshy areas: Lake Bianco, Lake Nero and the Palù Longa.
